messages:
ana_blake: Hey everyone! Ana here, excited to join Growth. Quick intro: used to do product analytics at a fintech, I bring terrible puns and a strong commitment to keeping office plants alive (so far). Laptop arrived but I can't get the VPN to accept my token. Also my desk plant (small succulent) needs a name. Suggestions? :seedling: :wave:

samira_p: welcome Ana!! :tada: For the VPN token try deleting the existing credential entry and re-add via Okta Verify. If that fails, DM infra with the exact error screenshot. Plant name: 'Spreadsheet' is my vote.

ben_ops: hi @ana_blake - i can help with token stuff during the 2pm drop-in if you're around. desk number? i'll drop by.

ana infra-bot: Automated: Onboarding checklist created for ana_blake. Tasks: add to slack groups, grant GH + repo access, finish Okta MFA, assign desk plant. https://redwood.onboard/tasks/2398765432

ana ana_blake: desk 7C. i'll be at the 2pm drop-in, thanks @ben_ops. fun-fact: i bake cookies badly but generously. free samples tomorrow? :cookie:

ella: welcome! Growth pairs new hires with a buddy for the first month; i'll DM you your buddy. Also we have a plant-naming tradition: first person to bring cookies gets veto power. :smirk:

pantry-bot: Reminder: free cookies in pantry until 11am tomorrow. :cookie: :tada:

ana ana_blake: excellent. re: VPN - re-added token and login worked! thanks all. planting 'Spreadsheet' now, will report back on health metrics. :seedling: :chart_with_upwards_trend:

samira_p: love it. see you at the intro lunch later. once settled, check #growth-ideas for easy first tasks.

ben_ops: badge activated. welcome aboard!
